description: This file provides utility functions for handling Matrix message attachments, including resolving media kinds, labels, captions, filenames, and formatting message texts with media status indicators.

methods.name: resolveMatrixMediaKind
methods.description: Resolves a message type string to a MatrixMessageAttachmentKind or null.

methods.name: resolveMatrixMediaLabel
methods.description: Generates a label for a media kind, with a fallback default.

methods.name: formatMatrixAttachmentMarker
methods.description: Formats a string marker for a media attachment, indicating size or availability issues.

methods.name: isLikelyBareFilename
methods.description: Determines if a string is likely a bare filename based on its format and extension.

methods.name: resolveCaptionOrFilename
methods.description: Resolves caption and filename from provided parameters, prioritizing filename if present.

methods.name: resolveMatrixMessageAttachment
methods.description: Creates a MatrixMessageAttachmentSummary object based on message parameters.

methods.name: resolveMatrixMessageBody
methods.description: Extracts the message body or caption from message parameters.

methods.name: formatMatrixAttachmentText
methods.description: Formats a text marker for a media attachment, considering size and availability.

methods.name: formatMatrixMessageText
methods.description: Formats the full message text, including body and media attachment marker.

methods.name: formatMatrixMessageSummaryText
methods.description: Formats message summary text, reusing the main message formatting function.

methods.name: formatMatrixMediaUnavailableText
methods.description: Formats message text indicating media is unavailable.

methods.name: formatMatrixMediaTooLargeText
methods.description: Formats message text indicating media is too large.
